summary: Iteration 4b polish verification. Backend regression: 47/47 pytest PASS (backend_test.py 28 + test_iteration2.py 19) — no changes since iter4. Frontend Shop /shop?type=posters now renders all 9 theme chips as expected: [Anime, Cars, Sports, Movies, Music, Fashion, Cities, Gaming, Motivational] — every chip present with correct data-testid (shop-theme-{slug}) and label, all clickable. Filter correctness confirmed against 4-product seed: theme=fashion -> only product-card-vogue-leopard; theme=movies -> only product-card-spider-man; theme=anime -> only product-card-tanjiro; theme=cars -> only product-card-ferrari-formula-1; theme in {sports, music, cities, gaming, motivational} -> 0 cards + 'Nothing here yet' empty state renders. themeFor() keyword heuristic buckets correctly (vogue/leopard -> fashion, spider -> movies, tanjiro -> anime, ferrari -> cars). Home page unchanged: hero-title renders 'Collect what you love.', hero-shop-btn navigates to /shop?type=posters, 4 featured product cards visible (spider-man, tanjiro, ferrari-formula-1, vogue-leopard). No console errors observed on Home or Shop.
critical_code_review_comments: Shop.jsx themeFor() is still a keyword heuristic over name+description. It works for the current 4 seeded products but is brittle for future admin-added products (e.g., a poster named 'Naruto Rasengan' without the substring 'anime' would fall into no theme chip). Recommend adding an explicit optional `theme` field on the Product model so admins can pick a bucket at create/edit time; keep the heuristic as fallback.

Shop.jsx TAXONOMY.posters.themes and backend categories are maintained as two independent lists. Consider deriving posters theme chips from GET /api/categories (filtered to poster-relevant slugs) so adding a new category server-side doesn't require a frontend edit.

Empty-state UX is correct (Nothing here yet) but does not deep-link back to 'All' theme; a small 'Show all posters' CTA inside the empty state would reduce dead-ends when a user hits sports/music/cities/gaming/motivational.
